design.quote: This retrospective cohort study analyzed consecutive patients who underwent DB-ERCP between January 2017 and February 2024. A total of 203 patients who were sedated with diazepam (n = 94) or midazolam (n = 109) were analyzed.
design.text: A retrospective cohort study comparing the effects of midazolam and diazepam sedation on DB-ERCP outcomes in 203 patients.
